About the Team
The Global Partnerships team lies at the heart of Twitch. Our team is dedicated to serving streamers in our Twitch Partner Program from around the world. Our partner managers are custodians of meaningful and enduring relationships with our Partners. Our operations managers lead the execution and efficiency of critical processes used to support the Partner experience. Our program managers design and implement initiatives that acknowledge and enable Partner success. Collectively, we shape and evolve the Partner Program with meticulous care. Every decision is guided by the diverse needs of our streamers, who are the essence of Twitch's success.
About the Role
The Sr. Global Creator Programs Manager owns the end-to-end execution of Twitch's global scaled creator activation program, a structured system that recruits, develops, and retains creators through community-driven programming and milestone-based progression. You'll build and operate the program's infrastructure, work with a distributed team of regional community leads, and drive creators toward meaningful retention milestones. Working cross-functionally with Partnerships, Product, Engineering, Business Development, and Marketing, you'll deliver against ambitious membership and retention targets, then report program performance to senior leadership.
You will report to the Sr. Manager of Global Creator Programs and you can work from Twitch’s headquarters in San Francisco, CA; or from one of our hub locations in Seattle, WA; Irvine, CA; or New York City, NY - with West Coast (PST) working hours.
You Will:
Own the operational strategy and execution of the scaled retention program: community infrastructure, progression systems, and cohort-based programming
Work closely with a team of contract-based regional community leads driving community operations, programming facilitation, and cohort support across priority markets
Design and run rolling cohort programs, including facilitator management and educational programming (webinar series, office hours)
Develop and execute regional go-to-market plans to drive program membership and creator activation
Own the creator verification pipeline, ensuring participants meet eligibility criteria and represent active, authentic creators
Define, track, and report program success metrics: membership, conversion, retention milestones, and time-to-graduation (how long a creator takes to complete the program)
Identify and mitigate program risks early, iterating on program design based on creator feedback and performance data
You Have:
6+ years in program management, community operations, or creator/influencer ecosystem roles (or equivalent experience)
A track record of building and scaling programs from early stage to thousands of participants
Experience working across distributed teams, including contractors or vendor relationships across multiple regions
Strong operational skills: you build systems, processes, and workflows that scale, and you partner effectively across Product, Engineering, Marketing, and Partnerships
A data-driven mindset, with comfort using AI and automation tools to improve program efficiency without compromising creator experience
Excellent written and verbal communication: you write effective narratives and present program strategy to Directors and VPs
Bonus Points
A Twitch enthusiast: you bleed purple!
Experience running cohort-based programs (accelerators, bootcamps, creator programs) and creator onboarding/retention
Familiarity with community platform architecture (Discord, Slack), bots, and automation tools
Fluency with data and PM tooling (Tableau, Mode, Salesforce, Airtable); multilingual or cross-market experience a plus

About Our Company
VIZ Media has been bringing the finest in manga, anime, and global entertainment to English-speaking fans across the world for nearly 40 years. From classic series like Dragon Ball, Sailor Moon, and Naruto to current hits like My Hero Academia, Demon Slayer, and Chainsaw Man, we continue to offer the best in action, romance, fantasy, and adventure stories for fans of all ages.
Our critically acclaimed manga, graphic novels, and books have won Eisner, YALSA, and Hugo awards and are available in both print and digital editions, and our premier catalog of anime titles can be seen on TV and via streaming and digital download, as well as in collectible Blu-ray and DVD sets at major retailers.
Learn more about VIZ Media, anime, and manga at 
www.viz.com
.
Job Summary
VIZ Media, the world leader in English-language versions of manga and anime (Japanese comics and animation), is looking for a Licensing Coordinator to support our CPG Licensing & Promotions department. The Licensing Coordinator supports the Consumer Products Licensing team by coordinating day-to-day licensing operations across multiple entertainment properties and licensed categories. This role serves as a central point of coordination between internal departments, licensors, licensing agents, and licensees to ensure licensing deals, approvals, reporting, and product lifecycles progress efficiently and on schedule. The Licensing Coordinator manages deal workflow, tracks approvals, prepares presentations and business materials, and supports partner, licensor, and cross-functional communications. This position is ideal for a highly organized, detail-oriented individual looking to build a career in consumer products licensing, entertainment, or brand management.
What you’ll do:
Coordinate day-to-day administrative support for the Consumer Products Licensing team across multiple product categories and territories.
Prepare Deal Memos and supporting documentation for internal and licensor approval.
Track licensing opportunities from deal submission through execution using internal project management systems.
Maintain accurate records of licensees, agreements, product categories, approvals, reporting, and key business milestones.
Coordinate execution of licensing agreements with Licensing, Contracts, Finance, and external partners.
Monitor renewal timelines and contract expiration dates, proactively notifying Licensing Managers of upcoming deadlines.
Assist in onboarding new licensees 
Serve as a liaison between licensees, licensing agents, licensors, and internal departments including Contracts, Product Development, Brand Assurance/Approvals, Marketing, Finance, and Legal.
Track approval timelines and follow up with internal and external stakeholders to ensure timely completion.
Assist with overdue payment and forecast reconciliation.
Coordinate sample requests for licensors, partners, internal stakeholders, and marketing initiatives
In addition to these responsibilities, perform other activities as assigned.
The ideal candidate has:
1–3 years of experience in licensing, consumer products, entertainment, or administrative support.
Exceptional organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously.
Strong attention to detail and commitment to accuracy.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
Proficiency in Google Suite, Microsoft Office, My Media Box, Canva, Asana, and Slack.
Ability to manage competing priorities and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to collaborate across multiple teams and external partners.
Bachelor's degree or equivalent combination of education and experience.
Nice to have:
Japanese language proficiency (reading, writing, and speaking) strongly preferred.
Experience working with licensors or international business partners.
Experience with royalty reporting or licensing administration.
Work Environment & Schedule
Location: The Licensing Coordinator position is open to candidates local to the San Francisco Bay Area. VIZ Media operates on a hybrid schedule, and the Licensing Coordinator should expect to work onsite at our Downtown San Francisco office 2 times per week. There may be some required travel for this position to attend conventions or trade shows.
Schedule: This is a Regular Full-Time position with flexibility in working hours outside of our core hours of 10:00am - 4:00pm.
Compensation: $65,000 - $75,000 annually, depending on experience, with additional variable compensation

Job Summary
VIZ Media, the world leader in English-language versions of manga and anime, is looking for a Senior or Executive Editor to join our Original Publishing team. The Senior Editor/Executive Editor, Original Publishing will commission and acquire commercially appealing books with an emphasis on Asian pop culture and entertainment. Titles may span a wide variety of formats and subjects, including illustrated books, novelty formats, cooking, general interest non-fiction, and more. Reporting to the Publishing Director, the Senior/Executive Editor will develop the trade list for the VIZ Media imprint, acquiring and editing approximately 10-15 original books per year. A significant amount of creative ideation and commissioning will be required. 
This role works closely with authors and agents, along with members of the editorial, design, production and marketing departments. Experience sourcing and collating images for illustrated/photographic books will be highly regarded. The final title for this position will be determined based on the candidate’s level of experience.
What you’ll do:
Manage new publishing projects from ideation to completion
Identify opportunities and commission authors and other creatives
Evaluate book proposals and build the commercial case for their acquisition
Undertake developmental and line edits, along with reviewing and collaborating on illustrated layouts
Negotiate and manage relationships with agents and authors
Engage with authors/agents throughout the acquisition and production process and ensure all relevant approvals and contracts are in place
Report on trends and audiences and highlight potential new areas for growth
Establish and manage production schedules
Collaborate with freelancers, copydesk, designers, art directors, and production
Prepare sales and marketing materials as required
The ideal candidate has:
8+ years of relevant publishing industry experience, including significant senior editorial experience with both prose and complex, full-color books
Direct experience managing multiple concurrent projects from acquisition to completion
A strong record of delivering projects to deadline with minimal supervision–effective organization and prioritization skills are a must
Extensive experience managing freelance creative teams (including designers, photographers, and writers)
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to successfully manage internal relationships
Ability to problem solve creatively with strong critical thinking skills and deep attention to detail
Demonstrated initiative with the ability to multitask and manage competing priorities
Understanding of and interest in the publishing, entertainment, and pop culture landscape; some knowledge of or interest in anime and manga a plus
Bachelor's Degree in English, Journalism, Creative Writing, Comparative Literature, Communications, or related fields from an accredited college or university, or equivalent experience
Work Environment & Schedule
Location: The Senior/Executive Editor, Original Publishing position is open to candidates residing and working in California, New York, New Jersey, Oregon, or Texas. If local to the San Francisco Bay Area, 1-2 days of work onsite at our downtown San Francisco office is expected weekly. If remote, the Editor should expect to travel to San Francisco 3-4 times per year.
Schedule: This is a Regular Full-Time position (40 hours per week) with core hours of 10 am to 4 pm with flexibility outside of core hours.
Compensation: $95,000 - $115,000 annually, depending on experience, with additional variable compensation

Job Summary
VIZ Media, the world leader in English-language versions of manga and anime (Japanese comics and animation), is looking for a Business Operations Associate to join our Original Publishing team. This is an exciting opportunity for a highly organized and detail-oriented candidate with a passion for publishing to join the Original Publishing team at VIZ Media. The team publishes a range of different formats, including manga, art books, cookbooks and novels. 
The Business Operations Associate will report to and assist the Senior Publishing Director, Original Publishing in facilitating the Original Publishing department’s publishing operations, ensuring all information is disseminated appropriately. This position is responsible for updating and maintaining internal databases and trackers, ensuring metadata and sales information is correct, and working closely with Publishing Operations, Publishing Production, Editorial and Sales. In addition, this role will ensure compliance with Licensor submission systems and will be responsible for some contracts administration and support.
What You’ll Do:
Gather and deliver all needed metadata and materials required for print and digital publishing distribution and coordinate with Editorial, Publishing Production, and Publishing Operations to ensure data is correct and up-to-date.
Navigate internal databases and trackers and communicate updates and changes as required.
Provide product information and materials to Sales and Marketing to support seasonal sales windows. 
Ensure compliance with Licensor submission requirements and system maintenance.
Assist the Publishing Director and Editors with submitting contract requests and ongoing contractual negotiations.
In addition to these duties, may perform other duties as assigned.
The Ideal Candidate has: 
2+ years of relevant business experience, preferably in an administrative capacity in publishing or relevant industry
Strong attention to detail and organizational skills
Intermediate experience in Excel, particularly with large datasets
Ability to prioritize and balance multiple projects simultaneously and manage time effectively
Proactive approach to projects
Ability to communicate and interact professionally with culturally diverse clients, vendors, and staff
Bachelor's Degree from an accredited college or university, or equivalent experience, with a record that demonstrates suitable preparation for this position
Additional Preferred Experience:
Proficiency with Adobe Creative Cloud programs, including InDesign, Photoshop, and Adobe Acrobat
Prior experience in publishing
Interest in anime and manga
Work Environment & Schedule
Location: The Business Operations Associate position is open to candidates local to the San Francisco Bay Area. This will be a hybrid position with 2 days of work onsite at our downtown San Francisco office expected weekly. 
Schedule: This is a Regular Full-Time position (40 hours per week) with core hours of 10 am to 4 pm with some flexibility as needed. 
Compensation: $70,000 - $80,000 annually, depending on experience, with additional variable compensation
